name: Neil Eric Cowd Memorial Scholarship (SCU Education)
summary: Up to $20,000 over four years for a Bachelor of Education student at SCU who faces hardship or disadvantage.
key: Paid as $5,000 a year for up to four years of full-time study.
who: Australian citizen or permanent resident, including permanent humanitarian visa holders.
Enrolled in the Bachelor of Education, on campus or online. New and current students can apply.
Shows a form of hardship or disadvantage.
how: Apply through SCU's applying for a scholarship page with a 100 to 200 word statement.
catches: Part-time study may be considered at a reduced value.
